content.text:
Chicken thigh boneless skinless has about 1.96 days left. The count was 47.9 lb (`inventory_counts.csv SITE-01 COUNT-CLOSE-CHICKEN rev1`). Last week's use was about 24.43 lb a day, from 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04.

Planning uses Alder deliveries on Monday and Wednesday, with orders due by noon the day before. That comes from note N09, which is quoted evidence and not a confirmed fact. The vendor sheet lists Monday and Thursday (`vendors.csv SITE-01 V1 rev1`), but it was last reviewed on 2026-09-14, so it may be stale.

The Monday delivery is the same on both sources. If Wednesday versus Thursday matters for your order, the Alder rep or a recent delivery receipt would settle it. I don't know whether the restaurant records actual delivery days anywhere other than invoices.
